findings.note: The Jets' team site says their pass defense ranks fourth in the NFL at 175 yards allowed per game. It also says New England's offensive line will be without two starters, LT Will Campbell and RG Mike Onwenu, after the Jets recorded 8 sacks against the Browns.

Maye is averaging 245.2 passing yards per game this season, which is below the 256.5 line, and New England's balanced offense runs for 127.2 yards per game. Most of his passing rebound came in the last two games after he struggled on deep throws in Weeks 1-3.

Ed Scimia of Covers picks the over at a lower line, 225+ passing yards, pointing to Maye's 643 yards over the last two games. He calls the Jets 12th in EPA per pass attempt and expects a close game. That pick does not directly address the 256.5 line.
